title: Zero-TAF Evidence Bundle
description: The decision case presented to an approver at escalation (ZT-013): context, matched rule, proposed action, options, provenance — assembled outside the model context (ZT-NM-OVR-1..3). The decision record carries only the bundle hash. Full-payload context is permitted here, unlike in the record.

matched_rule.description: The rule that triggered escalation, in approver-readable form (ZT-NM-OVR-2).

proposed_action.description: What the agent proposed; full payload permitted here.

options.description: The choices presented to the approver.

provenance.description: mandate_id, mandate_hash, task_identity — where the authority came from.

bundle_hash.description: Canonical hash over the bundle without this field; carried by the decision record as evidence_bundle_hash.
